Caméra au poing

Vloguer et filmer comme un pro, avec un téléphone et Bobine

A practical school of vlogging and filmmaking for creators who shoot on a phone: voice and rhythm, telling a day, light, sound, camera movement, scenes, production, documentary, sketch and music video, then editing with Bobine and learning from every post.

William Foteping · 30 sections · 38,354 words · about 174 minutes
